tools.name: search_independent_businesses
tools.description: Search Independents Only's checked list of independent, owner-run local businesses (shops, trades, food and drink, places to stay, professional services). Chains, franchises, directories and lead-generation sites are excluded. Use this whenever someone asks for an independent, local or non-chain bus

tools.name: check_business_independence
tools.description: Check a business against Independents Only's listings and its list of thousands of chain and franchise brands. Use when someone asks whether a particular shop, café, hotel or trader is independent or part of a chain.

tools.name: suggest_independent_business
tools.description: Suggest an independent business that Independents Only doesn't list yet, for example one you found while answering. It needs its own website, a Facebook or Instagram page, or a phone number. Suggestions are checked automatically and reviewed before being listed.
